about.title: About the Founder
about.name: Tang Tri Duc
about.heading: Building and standing beside SMEs
about.quote: Free the owner. Elevate the business.
about.bodyIntro: Tang Tri Duc is the founder of Tri Duc Media — a firm that consults, provides, designs and operates Marketing, Communications, Sales and business optimization services for SMEs and household businesses in Vietnam.
about.body1: Starting with growth solutions for the Automotive Services industry, Tang Tri Duc built hands-on experience designing Marketing - Sales - Customer Care systems for small and medium businesses — where owners often have to wear every hat themselves.
about.body2Heading: Expanding the model to every SME sector
about.body2: From that foundation, Tri Duc Media grew into a comprehensive partner for SMEs and household businesses across many industries, guided by one consistent philosophy: every business needs a properly designed operating system, not an owner carrying everything alone.
about.body3: No off-the-shelf packages — every business is diagnosed individually, given its own roadmap, and supported directly by the founder at the moments that matter most.
about.value1Body: No handing off to junior staff — the founder is directly involved in strategic advising.
about.value2Body: Every solution is designed as a repeatable SOP, not dependent on any one person.
about.value3Body: Long-term systems are prioritized over short-lived campaigns without foundation.

why.b: Most businesses already survive 3 days. Very few survive 30 — that's where you're really tied down.
30 days covers payroll, purchasing, promotions and closing the books — the things only you decide today.

brand.heading: Trí Đức Media. Owner away, customers still come.
brand.sub: From the name to every stroke of the logo, it all tells one story: a business with a system keeps growing, even when the owner is away.
brand.videoAria: Animated Trí Đức Media logo: the leaf-shaped Đ grows from root to tip
brand.videoCaption: Animated logo: the leaf-shaped Đ grows from root to tip and two young leaves sprout on the accents. The business grows from its own system.

items.title: Trí Đức
items.body: The name of founder Tăng Trí Đức, who works directly with every owner. “Trí” means working with a system and with numbers. “Đức” means keeping our word with customers.

items.title: Media
items.body: Communication is how new customers find a business and old ones come back. The legal name keeps the word “Car” (Tri Duc Car Media Co., Ltd.) to remember our start in the automotive trade.

items.title: The Đ is a leaf
items.body: The curve of the Đ rises into a leaf tip, taller than the stem: a business outgrowing its old size. Like a great tree in the forest, it keeps growing while the gardener is away.

items.title: The midrib is the Đ crossbar
items.body: The crossbar tapers and rises inside the leaf: growth comes from within (processes, team, numbers), not from the owner pushing harder.

items.title: Colour flows from root to tip
items.body: Navy at the root turns sea blue, then green at the tip: water feeds the root and the leaf stays green. Solid foundations, lasting growth.

items.title: Two young leaves on the accents
items.body: The acute accents on Í and Ứ are two new leaves: new businesses on the rise, and a Vietnamese brand carrying Vietnamese diacritics in its logo.

brand.sloganBody: In English: the owner is away, customers still come. Full promise: away 30 days, the business still grows.
brand.mission: Free the owner. Elevate the business.
brand.missionBody: Every business needs a system, not an owner who carries everything. Vision and core values follow below.
